reuse.why: Routes every ranged-amount site (template, forecast, two in app.ts, preview) through the existing exported getScheduledAmount helper that the UI already used, changing the rule only there.

duplication.why: The five midpoint copies are removed; three call sites still keep their own `null ? 0 : number ? v : getScheduledAmount(v)` dispatch although the helper already handles the numeric case.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the other schedule helpers, consumed by server and client alike.

scope.why: Only the rule, its call sites, comments and a focused unit test are touched.

maintainability.why: A future change to the expected amount of a range is a one-line edit in one helper.

disguised_duplication.where: No disguised copies; only the leftover redundant number/null dispatch at app.ts updateActions/postTransactionForSchedule and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, which is pre-existing site handling.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts; every site applying the ranged rule calls it.
